list: Official 55-trophy list, verified live 19 Nov 2026 against Exophase and PSNProfiles via Planet GTA 6 and OutputLag

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Platinum scope: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026; Press Start full trophy list, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, and it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours, so there is no separate task behind it beyond finishing everything else on this list. Treat it as a progress meter rather than a goal you chase directly: every tick in this tracker brings it one step closer, and the tracker itself is the best way to see what is left. The road is long rather than hard. OutputLag puts the platinum at around 200 hours, with the story alone taking roughly 50 to 60 hours, and the rest going to the 100 percent checklist behind A Long Road, the grinds like 250 stunts and 100 WAiNK locations, and the side-story finales. There are no difficulty trophies, no online trophies and no mission medals, so nothing here demands a perfect run or a multiplayer grind; it demands patience and a plan. The plan in this guide is six stages: finish the story, close the side stories, do the crime trophies, clear the activities, sweep the collectibles and money, then mop up the odd moments and the 100 percent checklist. Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch, and a single missed moment in Chapter 1 can otherwise cost a whole second playthrough. Do not use cheats on your trophy save: PowerPyx reports that turning on a cheat disables trophies, and GameSpot and PC Gamer add that you cannot save once you have used one. When this trophy pops, you are done.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Mission placement: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it, and this bronze trophy pops as the mission ends. It is the first story trophy most players will earn, and it cannot be missed: just play the story from the start and the trophy pops when the mission ends. There is no preparation, no side requirement and no choice to get wrong, since the mission introduces you to Leonida and the two leads, and the game walks you through everything it asks. If you are hunting the platinum, treat this mission as your warm-up and your reminder to start good habits early. Make your first manual save before you get deep into Chapter 1, because the save discipline that protects you later starts here, and the one missable moment in the whole list, Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, comes soon after. The fishing itself is also worth learning properly rather than rushing past it, because a later trophy, Baited My Tackle, asks you to beat Cal in a fishing challenge, and the mechanics you learn here carry straight over. The trophy is hidden on PlayStation until you earn it, so its name and description stay concealed on your console until it pops, which is why this tracker hides it behind the spoiler setting until you tick it off. Finish Gone Fishing, watch for the pop, and move on to Chapter 1 proper.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Chapter structure and save advice: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this bronze trophy pops as the chapter closes, though OutputLag notes that chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not panic if it is a few minutes late. It is unmissable: play the story through and it comes to you. The important thing about Chapter 1 is not this trophy but the one moment inside it that can be missed. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning, a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time, and she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task, because that meditation counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and it is gone once Chapter 1 ends. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs that one spot, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops, since that save is your insurance. Beyond that, Chapter 1 is your chance to learn the map, the driving and the combat at a gentle pace, and to try the first arcade game and the first fishing challenge, since Stick Fiddler and Baited My Tackle both have their roots here. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 and another at its end, then step into Chapter 2 knowing the only missable moment is already behind you.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Chapter 2 unlocks: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and this bronze trophy pops as the chapter closes, with the same small delay OutputLag warns about: chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene. It is unmissable, so the real value of Chapter 2 is what it unlocks rather than the trophy itself. Character switching opens right after Breakfast Run, the mission behind the Trust trophy, and from then on you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call the other one in as your partner, which is the key to the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy. Two systems that matter for the platinum also open here. The Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver unlocks the Vice City Real Estate app, where the eight garages behind Little Boxes are bought for about 160,000 dollars in total, and the mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app, where On the Spot asks you to register ten vehicles. The Kolt and Associates bowling alley, Kingpin Bowling, is an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2, and it is tied to the Let's Go Bowling trophy, so bring Sticky Bombs when you go. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, learn switching early, buy your first garage when you can afford it, and play the chapter through to its end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Chapter 3 timing and unlocks: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and this bronze trophy pops as the chapter closes, again possibly at the start of Chapter 4 rather than on the last cutscene. It is unmissable, but Chapter 3 holds two things you should not sleepwalk past. First, the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies, which is the whole setup for Sneakthief: go to a store's locked back door, use the Snap Gun on it, find the note with the safe code inside, open the safe and leave without being seen, because kicking the door in sets off the alarm and ruins the attempt. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and if someone spots you, reload rather than push on. Second, Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass icon, and that strand counts toward Strangers and Freaks, so save first and race the moment it appears rather than leaving it for later. Chapter 3 is also when most robbery trophies become possible, since the tools arrive through optional and story missions in the middle of the game. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, do Yago's race the moment it shows up, and finish the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Chapter 4 unlocks: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and this bronze trophy pops as the chapter closes, the last of the four chapter trophies before the finale. It is unmissable, and Chapter 4 is where the late-game robbery trophies open up, so play it with those in mind rather than rushing the story. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4, unlocks bank vaults: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open, and bring your partner because you cannot carry all the bags alone. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together, and five vaults in total earns Maximum Withdrawal, while the 100 percent checklist needs all eight. By now you should have your per-chapter manual saves in place, one at the start of each chapter, plus the habit of saving before anything time-sensitive. Keep a save at the start of Chapter 4, do the bank-vault mission when it appears, and finish the chapter knowing the finale is next. Once Chapter 4 is done, the only story trophy left is the gold for the final mission, and everything outside the story stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. No-mission-replay warning and save advice: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission and this gold trophy pops, the biggest story reward on the list and the last of the twelve story trophies. It is unmissable in the sense that finishing the story earns it, but the moment before it deserves more care than any other in the game. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch, so keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission and do not overwrite it, because it is your only way back if anything goes wrong or if you want to replay the ending. The game has fifteen manual save slots plus one autosave, so there is room to keep that save safe while you rotate the rest. Once the credits roll, everything outside the story stays available: the side-story finales, the 100 percent checklist, the collectibles, the grinds and the odd-moment trophies are all still there, and work you did earlier still counts toward them. The 100 percent checklist itself only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100 percent Completion, so the finale is really the point where the cleanup phase begins rather than the end of the hunt. Finish the final mission, take the gold, keep that pre-finale save, and then start Stage 2 of the roadmap with the whole open world still ahead of you.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Character switching unlock: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run and this bronze trophy pops when it ends. It is a story mission in Chapter 2, it cannot be missed, and it matters far beyond its own bronze because of what it unlocks. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run, and from then on you can switch characters and call the other one in as your partner, which is the foundation of the partner trophies. Hot Together needs you to lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat, Retail Therapy needs three shops robbed back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level, and several meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. Learn the switch early rather than leaving it until you need it: practise calling your partner in during free roam, get used to having them beside you in a fight or a getaway, and remember that the game expects the two of them together for much of the mid-game content. Several trophies need Jason and Lucia together, so most of the list opens up once both are playable in Chapter 2. Play Breakfast Run, take the trophy, and start thinking of the two leads as a pair from here on, because the platinum hunt is built around them working together.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist and this bronze trophy pops when it ends. It is a story mission, it cannot be missed, and the only thing it asks of you is to play the story through to that mission and finish it. Heist missions in this game tend to be longer and more demanding than ordinary story missions, so go in prepared rather than rushing: stock up on ammo and armour before you start, keep a manual save from before the mission, and remember that there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back if a run goes badly. The Cartel Heist sits among the bigger set-piece missions of the story, and finishing it is one of the twelve story trophies that make up Stage 1 of the roadmap, alongside the four chapter trophies and the other mission trophies. There is no side requirement, no collectible and no choice to get wrong, so if you are following the story you will earn it naturally. Treat it as a milestone: when it pops, you are deep into the story, the robbery systems are opening up around you, and the mid-game trophies like Sneakthief and the bank vaults are starting to come into reach. Finish the heist, bank the bronze, and keep playing.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play and this bronze trophy pops when it ends. It is a story mission, it cannot be missed, and like the other mission trophies on this list it asks nothing beyond playing the story through to that mission and finishing it. There is no preparation, no side requirement and no choice to get wrong, so if you are following the story you will earn it naturally as part of Stage 1 of the roadmap. The mission trophies are the spine of the platinum: twelve of the fifty-five trophies, including the four chapter trophies, the gold for the final mission and the seven named mission trophies, all pop as you play, and they account for more than a fifth of the list before you ever start grinding. That is why the roadmap puts the story first and tells you to keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: the story is the safest progress you will ever make, and the saves protect the one or two moments inside it that are not safe. Child's Play is one of the safe ones, so enjoy the mission, watch for the pop at the end, tick it off in the tracker, and keep moving through the story. The side stories, the robberies and the long grinds all wait until after the credits, and none of them is going anywhere.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners and this bronze trophy pops when it ends. It is a story mission, it cannot be missed, and it asks nothing beyond playing the story through to that mission and finishing it. The name is a stylised spelling, DWNFALL, and it is one of the hidden trophies, so it stays concealed on PlayStation until you earn it, which is why this tracker hides it behind the spoiler setting until you tick it off. There is no preparation, no side requirement and no choice to get wrong, so if you are following the story you will earn it naturally as part of Stage 1 of the roadmap, alongside the chapter trophies and the other named mission trophies. If you are hunting efficiently, use the story missions as your framework and fit the free-roam trophies around them rather than the other way round: try an arcade game when you pass one, scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you drive, and attempt a stunt when you see a jump, because all of that progress counts toward the long grinds while the story carries you forward. Headliners is a milestone on that road, not a detour. Finish the mission, watch for the pop, tick it off, and keep playing the story, because the next mission trophy is never far behind.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. VCIA airport detail: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown and this bronze trophy pops when it ends. It is a story mission, it cannot be missed, and it asks nothing beyond playing the story through to that mission and finishing it. The mission takes place at Vice City International Airport, VCIA, and it is worth remembering the layout of the airport while you are there, because a different trophy, Catch Me If You Can, also lives at VCIA: it asks you to steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge, and the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. You do not need to do that during the story mission itself, and you should not try to force it, but knowing the airport helps when you come back for the free-roam trophy later. The VCIA Takedown is one of the twelve story trophies in Stage 1 of the roadmap, and like the rest it pops naturally as you play. Keep a manual save before the mission, as you should before any big story mission, since there is no mission replay. Finish the takedown, watch for the pop, tick it off in the tracker, and note the airport in your mind for later, because you will be back at VCIA for a jet.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory and this bronze trophy pops when it ends. It is a story mission, it cannot be missed, and it asks nothing beyond playing the story through to that mission and finishing it. Operation missions in this game tend to be among the heavier combat set-pieces, so go in prepared: stock up on ammo and armour, bring your partner if the mission allows it, and keep a manual save from before you start, because there is no mission replay and a failed run costs you the whole mission rather than a checkpoint restart from the trophy's point of view. It is one of the twelve story trophies in Stage 1 of the roadmap, and with it the story spine of the list is nearly complete: only the final mission's gold remains after the chapter trophies and the named mission trophies. By the time you reach Operation Savage Glory you should be comfortable with Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you trigger by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming, because the Gunslinger trophy asks you to take down five enemies in a single use of it, and a big combat mission is a natural place to practise. Finish the operation, watch for the pop, tick it off, and keep your save discipline tight as the story heads toward its finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 100% checklist figures: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026; GGRecon trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion and this gold trophy pops, and it is the single biggest task on the whole list, worth 100 Gamerscore on Xbox and the reason OutputLag puts the platinum at around 200 hours. The 100 percent checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100 percent Completion, but work you do earlier still counts, so do not wait for the credits to start the grinds. The checklist figures OutputLag reports are demanding: 300 stunts, where the Cunning Stunts trophy only needs 250, 70 of the 80 Challenges, where One Last Thing only needs 50, 200 of the 277 base vehicle models discovered, where Whip It Good only needs 100, all 8 bank vaults, where Maximum Withdrawal only needs 5, and all 39 illegal operations, where Pest Control only needs one from each of the 9 gangs. That pattern repeats across the list: every counted trophy is a milestone on the way to a larger 100 percent target, so the smart approach is to keep going past each trophy rather than stopping when it pops. There are no difficulty trophies and no online trophies, so this is a long grind, not a hard one, and the checklist itself tells you exactly what is left. Open it the moment it appears after the story, work through it stage by stage, and let this trophy be the last one before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Stunt types and 100% figure: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts and this silver trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it, so you can watch the counter climb. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, which means almost any daring driving or flying you do in free roam is progress. The practical method is to treat stunts as a habit rather than a chore: attempt a stunt jump whenever you see one, fly under a bridge when you are in a plane, and base jump from high places when the chance comes, because the counter fills up across the whole playthrough without a dedicated grind if you keep at it. Do not stop at 250, though. The 100 percent checklist behind A Long Road needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy and let the extra fifty come naturally while you finish the rest of the list. There is no difficulty requirement and no time limit, and stunts stay available after the credits, so this is one of the safest trophies on the list. The only mistake OutputLag warns about is stopping at 250 and then having to come back for fifty more later. Keep the counter in mind, keep attempting stunts as you travel, and this silver will pop somewhere in the middle of your playthrough, on the way to the larger total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Nine activity types: GGRecon trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once and this bronze trophy pops. GGRecon reports that there are nine activity types in the game, and the trophy asks you to sample every one of them rather than master any of them, which makes it a tour of Leonida's side content rather than a grind. The sensible way to earn it is to treat it as a checklist for your first free-roam sessions: whenever the game offers you a new activity, a race, a shooting range, a drone race, fishing, an arcade game, a gym session or anything else with its own icon, try it once and move on. You do not need to win, finish first or earn a medal; trying it is enough, and the deeper trophies for each activity, like The Shootist for gold medals at the shooting range or Top Fun for winning a drone race at every location, are separate hunts that come later. Because the trophy only needs one attempt at each type, it is one of the quickest bronzes on the list once you know where the activities are, and it pairs naturally with exploring the map for The Goodtime State. If it has not popped after a long playthrough, check which activity type you have never touched, because the missing one is usually something you walked past a dozen times. Try them all, and it pops.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 42 medals across two ranges: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges and this silver trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. OutputLag reports that there should be two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them, so this is a substantial shooting challenge rather than a quick visit, and it is one of the few trophies on the list that asks for genuine skill rather than patience. The practical approach is to learn each challenge type before chasing gold: run a challenge a few times to learn the target patterns, the timing and the weapon handling, then push for the gold score once you know what it demands. Use the weapon the challenge gives you rather than fighting it, take the steady shots before the fast ones, and do not be afraid to leave a hard challenge and come back after you have improved at the range generally, because skill here transfers between challenges. There is no time limit and the ranges stay open after the credits, so you can spread the 42 medals across the whole playthrough. If a particular challenge resists you, practise it in short sessions rather than grinding it for an hour straight, since tired aim is worse aim. Gold all 42, and the silver is yours.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 14 locations: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location and this bronze trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks how many locations you have won at. OutputLag reports 14 Top Fun drone race locations, so you need at least one win at each of the fourteen, and a win at the same location twice does not help you. Drone racing is a flying skill, so the method is the same as for the shooting range: learn the course first, then race it. Fly a practice run to learn where the gates are, where the tight turns sit and where you can cut a corner without missing a gate, and only then push for the win. The drones handle differently from planes and cars, so give yourself a few races to get used to the controls before you judge whether a course is hard or you are just unfamiliar. There is no time limit, the locations stay open after the credits, and you can work through them one at a time between other trophies, which is the pleasant way to do it. If a location keeps beating you, leave it, win somewhere easier to keep your confidence up, and come back with more flying hours behind you. Win at all fourteen, and the bronze pops.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races and this bronze trophy pops, and the word different does the work: winning the same race twenty times does not count, so you need twenty distinct races across Leonida. That makes this trophy a tour of the racing scene rather than a grind, and it pairs naturally with the other activity trophies. The practical method is to take races as they come: enter a street race when you find one, try a different vehicle class when the game offers it, and keep a mental note of which races you have already won so you do not waste time repeating them. Racing rewards clean driving more than raw speed, so learn each course's braking points, avoid the barriers that cost you seconds, and pick a vehicle you can control rather than the fastest one on offer. The trophy does not demand that you win every race type or master any one of them, just that you win twenty different ones, and the races stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and no missable window. If you are short a few races late in the game, check the map for race icons you have never visited, because the missing ones are usually in a corner of Leonida you have not explored yet. Win twenty different races, and it pops.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge and this bronze trophy pops. Cal is the fishing rival, and the challenge is a head-to-head contest rather than a casual fishing trip, so you need to know how the fishing works before you take him on. Learn the mechanics in the opening mission Gone Fishing and in free-roam fishing first: how to cast, how to read the bite, how to play a fish without snapping the line, and which bait and spots the game favours. The challenge is a contest of catches, so steady technique beats frantic reeling, and a fish lost to a snapped line is a fish Cal does not need to beat. If you lose to Cal, you can try again, so treat the first attempt as a scouting run: learn his pace, learn what the challenge counts, and come back with a better plan. There is no missable window and fishing stays available after the credits, so there is no pressure to beat him the first time you meet him. The trophy is a small, charming one, and it is best earned early, when the fishing is still fresh and the mechanics are still fun rather than a chore. Beat Cal, and the bronze is yours, with the fishing skills ready for anything else the game asks of you.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.targetLabel: Any of the 4 in-game arcade games
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Four in-game arcade games: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game and this bronze trophy pops. OutputLag reports that any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so you do not need to hunt for a specific machine or a specific title: find an arcade, sit down at any of the four games, and play it through to completion. The word complete is doing the work here, so a quick go that you abandon halfway does not count, and you need to see a game through to its end, whether that means finishing its levels, reaching its conclusion or surviving to its end screen, depending on the game. Pick the one that suits you best: if you are good at one genre and hopeless at another, play to your strength, because the trophy does not care which of the four you finish. Arcade games are scattered around Leonida, and they stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and no missable window. It is one of the quickest bronzes on the list, a pleasant break from the story and the grinds, and a good first trophy to chase in a free-roam session. Find an arcade, finish a game, and it pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Andy questline stays open after the story, Lucia-only: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy and this bronze trophy pops. Andy's questline is one of the six side-story finales on the list, alongside Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, and OutputLag reports that they should all stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and no missable window. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, which means you need to be playing as Lucia to work through it, so switch to her when you want to progress it. The important detail about Andy's strand, and Billy's and Tyrone's too, is that it does not count toward Strangers and Freaks: OutputLag is explicit that only some optional questlines count toward that silver, and Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the Strangers and Freaks progress counter after each strand you finish, because if it moved, that strand counted, and if it did not, it was one of the ones with its own trophy. Work through Andy's missions as they come, in free roam between story missions or after the credits, and finish the final one. The finale is the trophy, and there is no separate task beyond reaching the end of the questline.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Side-story finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton and this bronze trophy pops. Kenton's questline is one of the six side-story finales on the list, alongside Andy, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, and OutputLag reports that they should all stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and no missable window. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear, in free roam between story missions or in the cleanup phase after the credits, and finish the final one. The finale is the trophy, and there is no separate task beyond reaching the end of the questline. Kenton's strand is one of the ones that may or may not count toward Strangers and Freaks, since OutputLag says only some optional questlines count toward that silver, and the safe method is to check that trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish: if it moved, that strand counted, and if it did not, it was one of the ones with its own trophy. Either way, Kenton's finale earns you this bronze regardless, so there is nothing to lose by doing it. Take the missions as they come, enjoy the side story for what it is, and finish the last mission for Kenton to take the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Billy questline, and the Strangers & Freaks exclusion: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy and this bronze trophy pops. Billy's questline is one of the six side-story finales on the list, alongside Andy, Kenton, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, and OutputLag reports that they should all stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and no missable window. Work through Billy's missions as they appear, in free roam between story missions or in the cleanup phase after the credits, and finish the final one. The finale is the trophy, and there is no separate task beyond reaching the end of the questline. The important detail is that Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers and Freaks: OutputLag is explicit that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's questlines do not count toward that silver, because they have their own trophies, so do not expect the counter to move when you finish Billy's finale. Check the counter after each strand you finish anyway, because that is how you learn which strands count and which do not, and you need eight counting strands for the silver. Take Billy's missions as they come, finish the last one, and take the bronze, knowing the Strangers and Freaks counter is a separate hunt.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Only some strands count; Yago race time-sensitive in Chapter 3: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida and this silver trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress as 0 out of 8, so you can see how many strands you have finished. The catch is that only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies, so you need eight strands from the other strangers you meet across the state. The practical method is to check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. If it moved, that strand counted; if it did not, it was one of the ones with its own trophy. Work through stranger encounters as you find them in free roam and in the story, and do not leave them all for the end: one strand is time-sensitive, and that is the one that makes this trophy at-risk rather than safe. Race Against Yago, in Yago's street racing strand in Chapter 3, carries an hourglass icon, so save first, then race the moment it appears, because if that strand is one of your eight and you miss its window, the count gets harder. Everything else about this trophy is forgiving: the strands stay available after the credits, and the counter tells you exactly where you stand. Finish eight counting strands, and the silver pops.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Side-story finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy and this bronze trophy pops. Randy's questline is one of the six side-story finales on the list, alongside Andy, Kenton, Billy, Tyrone and Bret, and OutputLag reports that they should all stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and no missable window. Work through Randy's missions as they appear, in free roam between story missions or in the cleanup phase after the credits, and finish the final one. The finale is the trophy, and there is no separate task beyond reaching the end of the questline. Randy's strand is one of the ones that may or may not count toward Strangers and Freaks, since OutputLag says only some optional questlines count toward that silver, and the safe method is to check that trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish: if it moved, that strand counted, and if it did not, it was one of the ones with its own trophy. Either way, Randy's finale earns you this bronze regardless, so there is nothing to lose by doing it. Take the missions as they come, enjoy the side story for what it is, and finish the last mission for Randy to take the trophy, one of seven side-story trophies in Stage 2 of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Tyrone questline Jason-only, and the Strangers & Freaks exclusion: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone and this bronze trophy pops. Tyrone's questline is one of the six side-story finales on the list, alongside Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Bret, and OutputLag reports that they should all stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and no missable window. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only, which means you need to be playing as Jason to work through it, so switch to him when you want to progress it. The important detail is that Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers and Freaks: OutputLag is explicit that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's questlines do not count toward that silver, because they have their own trophies, so do not expect the counter to move when you finish Tyrone's finale. Check the counter after each strand you finish anyway, because that is how you learn which strands count and which do not, and you need eight counting strands for the silver. Work through Tyrone's missions as they appear, in free roam between story missions or after the credits, and finish the final one. The finale is the trophy, and there is no separate task beyond reaching the end of the questline.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 18 spots, purple icons, partner counting twice, Chapter 1 balcony meditation: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida and this bronze trophy pops, and this is the one trophy on the whole list that can truly be missed, so read this guide carefully before you finish Chapter 1. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time: switch to the other character, call them in, and meditate together to get the most out of each spot. The missable one is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning, a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time: she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate, and if you follow her and accept the optional task, it counts. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends. It is not confirmed that Positive Mental Attitude strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops, because that save is your insurance. PlayStation tracks it as 0 out of 18, so you can see how many spots are left, and the other 17 spots stay available after the credits. Do the balcony one first, then work through the rest at your leisure.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Bret hunting questline, Jason-only, clean head or heart shot: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret and this bronze trophy pops. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only, so you need to be playing as Jason to work through it, and it sends you after animals through target decks, which means each hunt has a specific animal to find rather than a general hunting trip. OutputLag reports that a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, so take the careful shot rather than the quick one: line up the animal, aim for the head or the heart, and fire once rather than spraying. A messy kill may still count as a kill, but a pristine carcass is what the questline is asking for, and the clean shot is the difference between a good hunt and a wasted one. The questline should stay available after the credits, like the other side-story finales, so there is no rush and no missable window. Work through Bret's targets as they come, in free roam between story missions or in the cleanup phase after the credits, and hunt the unique animal the questline asks for. The hunt is the trophy, and there is no separate task beyond reaching the end of Bret's questline and bringing down the animal it names.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets and this silver trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida, and a set is a group of cards that belong together, so you need to find every card in three complete sets rather than just any three cards. The practical method is to treat card hunting as a background task across the whole playthrough: pick up cards whenever you find them, note where you found them, and keep an eye on which sets are nearly complete so you can focus on the missing cards. Cards are a collectible in the classic sense, which means they are hidden in the world rather than handed to you, and the ones you are missing are usually in a place you have not explored yet, so the trophy pairs naturally with The Goodtime State, which asks you to explore all of Leonida. There is no time limit, the cards stay available after the credits, and nothing about the trophy is missable, so you can take your time and enjoy the hunt. If you are stuck on a final card, retrace your steps through the areas you have visited least, because the missing card is usually there. Complete three sets, and the silver pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. WAiNK scanning also discovers vehicles: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations and this silver trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. WAiNK is the in-game app you use to scan and tag locations, and the trophy asks you to use it in a hundred different places across Leonida, which makes it an exploration trophy as much as a collectible one. The practical method is to make WAiNK a habit: whenever you arrive somewhere new, a landmark, a shop, a viewpoint or any place that looks worth tagging, open the app and WAiNK it before you move on. Do it as you travel rather than as a separate grind, because a hundred locations is a lot to do in one sitting but a natural number across a full playthrough. WAiNK also does double duty: OutputLag reports that scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and you make progress on Whip It Good at the same time. There is no time limit, the locations stay available after the credits, and nothing here is missable, so the only mistake is forgetting to use the app. Tag a hundred locations, and the silver pops, with a hundred vehicles probably discovered along the way.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Challenges list and 100% figure: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges and this bronze trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and OutputLag reports that there are 80 of them in total, with the 100 percent checklist needing 70, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a larger target rather than the end of the hunt. The good news is that many challenges complete on their own while you play: they cover the things you are already doing, driving, shooting, exploring, robbing and collecting, so a large part of the fifty will fill in naturally across a full playthrough. The practical method is to check the Challenges list regularly, see which ones are close to done, and finish those first, because a challenge at 90 percent is a quicker trophy than one at 10 percent. Do not stop at 50: keep going toward 70, since A Long Road needs it, and the challenges you finish for this trophy are the same ones the checklist counts. There is no time limit, the challenges stay available after the credits, and nothing here is missable. Work the list, finish fifty, and the bronze pops on the way to seventy.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Bank vaults give 4 stars and double as Hot Together: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat, and this bronze trophy pops. The key detail is the partner: you need Jason and Lucia together, which means character switching must be open, and that opens right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, so this trophy is not available before then. Call your partner in, get yourselves a 4-star Wanted Level, and then lose the police and escape the heat together. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until the heat is fully gone and do not stop early. The easiest way to earn it is to combine it with Maximum Withdrawal: bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4, and vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this trophy at the same time. Bring your partner because you cannot carry all the vault bags alone anyway. If you earn it separately, pick a fast car, a route you know, and a place to hide, and keep your partner with you until the heat is gone. Lose the heat together, and it pops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Chain rule and 30-second delay: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level, and this bronze trophy pops. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The chain is the whole challenge: if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks, so you need to keep the Wanted Level alive across all three robberies. Pick three shops close together, plan your route between them before you start, and move fast from one to the next without stopping to fight the police or hide. Your partner needs to be with you for all three, so call them in before the first robbery and keep them close. OutputLag notes that the trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth, because the pop is delayed and robbing a fourth shop too soon can confuse the count. If the chain breaks, the police level drops or your partner wanders off, reset and try again with a better route. Three shops, one chain, partner beside you, and the bronze pops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. WAiNK scanning discovers vehicles; 100% figure: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles and this bronze trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. OutputLag reports that scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so the practical method is to scan traffic as you drive: point the app at cars you pass, scan the ones you have never seen before, and let the counter climb while you travel. You do not need to steal, buy or drive the vehicles, just discover them, which makes this a much gentler trophy than it sounds. Do not stop at 100: the 100 percent checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past this trophy and let the extra hundred come naturally while you finish the rest of the list. The vehicles you are missing late in the game are usually the rare ones, so vary your routes, visit different parts of Leonida, and scan everything you see rather than only the cars you like. There is no time limit, the vehicles stay available after the credits, and nothing here is missable. Scan a hundred vehicles, and the bronze pops on the way to two hundred.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Combat Focus controls and Adrenaline: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus and this bronze trophy pops. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming, and time slows so you can line up shots that would be impossible at full speed. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle, because you need five takedowns before the Focus runs out. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if you have it, and choose your moment: a group of enemies standing close together, with no cover between you and them, is worth more than five enemies spread across a battlefield. Do not waste the Focus on the first enemy you see; wait until you have a clear group, trigger it, and work through them methodically, one shot at a time, rather than spraying. If you run out of Focus with four down, reset and try again with a better group, because the trophy needs all five in a single use. There is no time limit and the enemies respawn, so you can practise the timing until it clicks. Five in one Focus, and the bronze pops.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Boarding-bridge jets at gates E3 and E4, 1 km delay: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA and this bronze trophy pops. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge. Planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and OutputLag reports that the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, so go to one of those gates rather than grabbing the first plane you see. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 kilometre away from the airport and it pops, so do not land or turn back too soon, and do not assume it failed just because nothing happened on the runway. Save first, because the police come fast, and an airport theft with a jet draws attention that a car theft does not. The practical method is to arrive at the airport with a plan: know which gate you are heading for, move quickly from the terminal to the cockpit, and get airborne before the response builds up. Once you are a kilometre out and the trophy pops, you can relax and fly wherever you like. A jet, a boarding bridge, a kilometre of sky, and the bronze is yours.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Rhino tanks at Mile Zero Air Station: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank and this bronze trophy pops, and the description, Kinda hot in these Rhinos, is the hint: Rhino is the name of the tank, and the trophy is about getting into one and driving it. OutputLag reports that tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map, so head there rather than searching the whole of Leonida for a tank. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops, because the trophy may need a moment of driving rather than just sitting in the hatch. A military base is not a friendly place, so expect a response when you take a tank, and have an escape route in mind: the tank itself is the escape route, since it is heavily armoured and armed, but it is also slow and conspicuous. The method is simple, which is part of the charm: find the tanks, climb into one, and drive. If the first tank you find does not trigger the trophy, drive it around and fire the cannon, because the pop may need you to actually use the vehicle rather than just sit in it. A Rhino, a drive, and the bronze pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, safe code note, Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected and this bronze trophy pops. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies, so do that mission first if you have not already, because the Snap Gun is the tool this trophy is built around. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it. Kicking the door in sets off the alarm, and the alarm ruins the attempt, so the Snap Gun is not optional, it is the method. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and if someone spots you, reload rather than push on, because a detected robbery cannot be salvaged into an undetected one. The trophy is about patience rather than speed: move quietly, watch the staff, and leave the moment you have the safe open rather than lingering for more loot. Save before you start, pick your store, use the Snap Gun, read the note, open the safe, and walk out unseen, and the bronze pops.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Vaults via That's Where The Money Is, partner needed, 4-star escape: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape, and this silver trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4, so you cannot start this trophy before then. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner, and that is also how you earn Hot Together at the same time, because vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, and escaping one with your partner earns that bronze too. The escape is part of the trophy, not an afterthought: the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until the heat is fully gone. Do not stop at five vaults if you are hunting the platinum, because the 100 percent checklist needs all eight, so keep going past this trophy and let the extra three come naturally. Plan each vault like a heist, with your partner, a fast car and a route out, and five clean escapes earns the silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Escape only counts after leaving the red heat zone: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape, and this bronze trophy pops. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida, and robbing one is a classic GTA move: stop the truck, get into the back, take the money, and get away. The escape is part of the trophy, not an afterthought, and the same rule that applies to the bank vaults applies here: the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until the heat is fully gone and do not stop early. Pick your spot before you strike: a quiet stretch of road where you can stop the truck without too many witnesses, a fast car waiting nearby, and a route away that does not run straight into a police station. The robbery itself is the easy part, and the escape is where the trophy is won or lost, so plan the getaway first and the robbery second. There is no time limit, the trucks keep coming, and nothing here is missable, so if a run goes wrong, reset and try again with a better spot. Rob the truck, leave the heat zone behind, and the bronze pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and this bronze trophy pops. Leonida is the state the game is set in, Vice City and the wider world around it, and the trophy asks you to visit every part of it rather than just the places the story takes you. The practical method is to treat exploration as a background task across the whole playthrough: whenever you are travelling between missions, take a different road, visit a town you have never seen, drive to the edge of the map and see what is there. The trophy pairs naturally with the other exploration trophies, because WAiNK It at a hundred locations, discovering a hundred vehicles and finding the collectible cards all take you to the same far corners of the map. If the trophy has not popped after a long playthrough, the missing piece is usually a small corner you never had a reason to visit, so check the map for areas that look unexplored and drive there deliberately. There is no time limit, the whole map stays open after the credits, and nothing here is missable, so you can finish it in the cleanup phase if the story never took you everywhere. Explore every region, and the bronze pops when the last one is visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 9 gangs, 39 operations for 100%: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang and this bronze trophy pops. OutputLag reports that there are nine gangs in the game, and you need one illegal operation robbed from each of them, which makes this trophy a tour of Leonida's criminal underworld rather than a single robbery. Illegal operations are the gang-run businesses scattered across the map, and robbing one means going in, taking what is there, and getting out, which is also how you practise the combat and stealth the other crime trophies need. The practical method is to keep a mental list of which gangs you have robbed and which you have not, because the trophy needs all nine and it is easy to rob the same gang twice while missing another one entirely. Do not stop at nine gangs if you are hunting the platinum, because the 100 percent checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way to a much larger total, and the operations you rob for it are the same ones the checklist counts. There is no time limit, the operations stay available after the credits, and if you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so nothing here is missable. Rob one operation from each of the nine gangs, and the bronze pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. No confirmed unlock method at launch: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach and this bronze trophy pops. The description is the whole hint, and OutputLag is honest that this is one of the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch: the description above is the only hint, and some of these odd-moment trophies may pop while you play normally. The method, as far as anyone can say on launch day, is to go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or a spot with a view where you can order a cocktail, and enjoy it. Ocean Beach is the beachfront of Vice City, so look for a beach bar, a rooftop or a terrace with a view over the water, and try ordering a drink there. If it does not pop the first time, try a different spot on the beach, a different time of day, or with your partner beside you, because the exact trigger has not been pinned down yet. That is the honest state of this trophy on 19 November 2026: the name and the description are official, the method is not confirmed, and the best advice is to visit Ocean Beach, have a cocktail with a view, and let the trophy come to you. It is not missable as far as anyone knows, and the beach is always there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. No confirmed unlock method at launch: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style and this bronze trophy pops. The description is the whole hint, and OutputLag is honest that this is one of the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch: the description above is the only hint, and some of these odd-moment trophies may pop while you play normally. The method, as far as anyone can say on launch day, is to drive a car into a vehicle showroom, or steal one from inside it, and smash your way out through the glass in the classic style the description evokes, the way the old games let you drive straight through a showroom window. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, get a car inside or line one up outside, and drive through the window rather than using the door. If it does not pop the first time, try a different showroom, a faster car, or a cleaner smash, because the exact trigger has not been pinned down yet. That is the honest state of this trophy on 19 November 2026: the name and the description are official, the method is not confirmed, and the best advice is to find a showroom, smash out of it in style, and let the trophy come to you.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Kingpin Bowling, Sticky Bombs, three key valuables: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley and this bronze trophy pops. The Kolt and Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2, and OutputLag reports the method: bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables, the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb, then escape the police. The follow-through in the description is the bowling follow-through, but the trophy itself is about robbing the bowling alley properly: get all three valuables, not just one or two, and get out. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable, and you can return and finish the job. The practical method is to go in prepared: bring Sticky Bombs, know where the three valuables are before you start, and have an escape route ready, because the police will come once the robbery is underway. The trophy is a small, specific one, and it is best earned the first time you visit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, when the operation is fresh and the valuables are all there. Take all three, escape, and the bronze pops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Jason and Lucia both at maximum Strength, gym with partner: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership with mass appeal and this bronze trophy pops, and OutputLag reports what that means: it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you, and work both characters up to maximum Strength rather than just one. The gym is the method: bench press, train regularly, and bring your partner every time, because training together is what builds both characters at once. This is a slow trophy rather than a quick one, since maximum Strength takes repeated gym sessions, so treat it as a background task: visit the gym between missions, train for a while, and let the Strength stat climb across the playthrough. There is no time limit, the gyms stay open after the credits, and nothing here is missable, so the only mistake is forgetting to train the second character. If you have been training as Jason alone, switch to Lucia, bring Jason along, and train her up too. When both of them hit maximum Strength together, the bronze should pop, and the method is unconfirmed at launch, so if it does not pop exactly at maximum, keep training and check for other gym activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 500 actions changing the Criminal Profile: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your Criminal Profile and this bronze trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. OutputLag reports that 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile are needed, and that robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. The practical method is to play the game the way the game wants you to play it: rob shops and operations, get into fights, make choices in missions, and let the counter climb across the whole playthrough. There is no specific action to repeat five hundred times, and no single trick to it, because the trophy counts the sum of your criminal life rather than one repeated deed. The choices in the description are the choices you make as you play, for better or worse, and the game tracks them in your Criminal Profile, which you can check to see how the count is growing. If it has not popped by the end of the story, keep playing in free roam: rob a few more shops, take on a few more fights, and the counter will reach five hundred on its own. There is no time limit and nothing here is missable. Live the criminal life, and the bronze pops at five hundred.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars laundering Marked Bills through your contacts and this bronze trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and they are laundered by selling them to your contacts, so the trophy is really about doing the robbery jobs and then moving the money through the people you know. The 250,000 dollar total is cumulative, which means you do not need to launder it all at once, and every bill you move adds to the total. The practical method is to do the bank and payday loan jobs as they come, collect the Marked Bills, and sell them to your contacts whenever you have a batch, rather than letting them pile up. The trophy pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal, because the bank vaults are one of the sources of Marked Bills, and with Pest Control, because the illegal operations are the other side of the same criminal economy. There is no time limit, the jobs stay available after the credits, and nothing here is missable. Keep robbing, keep laundering, watch the counter climb, and the bronze pops at 250,000 dollars.

The practical method is to spend normally across the whole playthrough rather than saving it all for one shopping trip, because a hundred thousand dollars is a lot to spend at once but a natural total across a full game of buying ammo, clothes and upgrades. If you reach the end of the story and you are short, the fastest way to close the gap is to buy the expensive things you have been putting off: a good weapon, a full wardrobe, or upgrades for a car you love, since the trophy counts the spending, not what you buy. Garages the story gives you do not count, so you need to buy all eight yourself, even if the story has already given you somewhere to park. Buy a garage, register a car, repeat, and the two trophies progress together. trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Moses opens Scooter Bros; Respray then Register; Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app and this bronze trophy pops, and PlayStation tracks your progress toward it. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app, so you cannot start this trophy before then. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register, and the car counts toward the ten. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray, which gives you a second way to do it. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first, because a car with nowhere to park cannot be registered, and the Little Boxes trophy, which asks you to buy all eight garages, is the natural partner for this one. The practical method is to register cheap cars rather than rare ones: steal an ordinary car, take it to Moses or to Pay 'n' Spray, register it, and move on to the next one, because the trophy counts the registrations, not the value of the cars. Ten registrations is a quick trophy once the app is open and you have garage space. There is no time limit, the app stays open after the credits, and nothing here is missable. Register ten vehicles, and the bronze pops.
